اعتمدا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَدَا (iʕtamadā) /iʕ.ta.ma.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اُعْتُمِدَا (uʕtumidā) /uʕ.tu.mi.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اِعْتَمِدَا (iʕtamidā) /iʕ.ta.mi.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
